name: タイムスタンプフォレンジック
description: Cross-references creation, modification, and digitized timestamps to detect temporal anomalies indicating AI generation or tampering. Validates timestamp consistency across multiple EXIF fields.
algorithm: マルチタイムスタンプ相互参照アナライザー
mechanism:
The timestamp forensics analysis performs comprehensive temporal validation:

1. **Multi-field Collection**: Gathers all available timestamp fields — DateTimeOriginal, CreateDate, DateTimeDigitized, ModifyDate, DateTime, GPSDateTime, SubSecTimeOriginal — providing a complete temporal picture.

2. **Temporal Consistency Analysis**: Validates logical ordering — DateTimeOriginal ≤ DateTimeDigitized ≤ ModifyDate. Violations indicate metadata manipulation.

3. **Anomaly Detection**: Identifies future dates, epoch timestamps (1970-01-01), default values (0000:00:00), timezone inconsistencies, and suspiciously round timestamps (exactly on the hour).

4. **Time Span Analysis**: Measures intervals between capture events. Camera bursts show millisecond intervals, while fabricated timestamps show unusual gaps or identical values.

5. **SubSecond Precision**: Checks for sub-second timing data (SubSecTimeOriginal), which is present in modern cameras but absent in most AI-generated images.
parameters:
Timestamp fields: DateTimeOriginal, CreateDate, DateTimeDigitized, ModifyDate, DateTime, GPSDateTime, SubSecTimeOriginal
Formats: EXIF (YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS), ISO 8601
Anomaly patterns: epoch date, future date, identical timestamps, missing subsecond data
Expected ordering: Original ≤ Digitized ≤ Modified
accuracy: Medium-High - 75-85%. Effective when multiple timestamps are present. Less reliable when only one timestamp exists.
useCase: Temporal integrity verification in forensic pipelines. Detects timestamp manipulation in both AI-generated and manually tampered images. Essential for establishing image chronology in legal contexts.
strengths:
• マルチフィールド相互参照で不整合を検出
• サブ秒データは強力なカメラ真正性指標
• AI生成と手動改ざんの両方を検出
• 時間的順序検証は非常に信頼性が高い
• GPSタイムスタンプとの併用で追加検証
limitations:
• カメラ時計がユーザーにより誤設定される場合
• 単一タイムスタンプのフォレンジック価値は限定的
• AIツールのタイムスタンプ生成が改善中
• タイムゾーン処理がデバイスにより異なる
• バッチ処理で同一タイムスタンプの可能性
